features.title: Check walls at the size you will print
features.description: Free Meshy analysis uses your working model and print dimensions. See thin-area percentages and unknown results without treating them as physical print approval.

features.title: Advanced Meshy options
features.description: Choose FDM, SLA or full-color, use model dimensions or a custom print size, and tune the remesh triangle target. Save global defaults or override individual designs.

features.title: Repair without losing your original
features.description: A separate action explicitly approves Meshy repair credits. Repaired sculpt geometry becomes a new candidate, OpenLOCK is rebuilt locally, and final geometry is checked again. Saved tasks resume without resubmission.
